title: Defend: pool slot fd cleared to -1 at acquire, preventing double-close in cleanup race
description: In crypto2dev_pool_acquire, when a slot with a ready fd is leased to the caller, pool->slots[i].fd is immediately set to -1 before releasing the lock. This prevents crypto2dev_pool_cleanup (which closes slots where fd >= 0) from also closing the fd that was just handed to the caller. Without this clearing, a concurrent cleanup could close the same fd the caller is using, causing the OS to reuse the fd number for a different file and the caller's subsequent ioctl to hit the wrong kernel object. The same 'clear before returning' pattern appears in the empty-slot open path. Do not change this to store the fd and use a separate 'leased' flag — the dual flag+value approach would require a larger critical section.
